capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 62 kWh gross pack has 58 kWh usable (VW figure relayed by SlashGear 2023; ArenaEV 2024 lists 58 usable). Same pack compared 2023 to 2025 (nothing shows a change).

chemistry.notes: Estimated, weak guess (OWNER FLAG): no page found states the 62 kWh pack chemistry (The Weekly Driver and Guide Auto say only lithium-ion; one EV Database listing for a later 58 kWh usable ID.4 shows LFP). nmc is assumed because thinkEV lists NMC for the 82 kWh MEB pack and Wikipedia says both packs use 24-cell modules; this is a different pack, so verify before trusting.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Canadian 2025 Base page lists 62.0 kWh at 400 V; ArenaEV calls the 2024 Standard pack "400V type". Same MEB pack all years.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: lineup-wide VW statement "most 2024 and newer VW EVs" (screens from a 2024 ID.4 Pro S) carried to MY2025 (same 2024-update software generation per model notes).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 62 kWh pack peaks at 140 kW (Cars.com 2024; SlashGear 2023). Same 62 kWh pack compared 2023 to 2025.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 11 kW onboard charger (VW 2021 launch release relayed by ConceptCarz; SlashGear 2023: 11 kW on both packs; vw.com 2026 page: up to 11 kW home charging). Same charger compared 2021 to 2026 (nothing shows a change).
